'''Corran Antillies Court of the vile mandolarian''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Corran Antillies]]
* '''Published:''' 14 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Vile Antillies DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is my first attempt at a Court deck.  It is based around Jodo Cast shooting up people and capturing them.

== Strategy ==

Basically I try to get all my effects out as fast as possible.  Simultaneasly, I pull Jodo with audience chamber.  I then try to get him, with Vader's Cape, armed and ready to capture the enemy however possible.  The other bounty hunters are there to take on characteristics of Mandolarians.  Once I get the Objective flipped, I feed everybody to the Sarlacc.

This Deck has really had next to no success the few times I played it. Please Help me.  I have a small pool of cards to work with.  Not much after Special edition and none after Reflections II.
